field_mappings.transformation: Parse the whole Trustee ABN cell as an Australian Business Number with checksum validation, without requiring a type label, and emit it as the trustee entity's ABN.

unmapped_fields.reason: Trustee Name is a generic native header. No original source wording establishes it as the registered or legal name of the RSE licensee, and the mapping draws from three sheets without a current/historical rule, so entity.legal_name is unsupported and this field is left unmapped.
Fund ABN identifies the superannuation fund rather than the trustee entity; the ontology's entity.abn is the business subject's ABN, so it is not mapped to avoid subject misattribution.
Fund Name names the superannuation fund rather than the trustee legal entity; mapping it to entity.legal_name would misattribute the subject.
Registration Number is an APRA registration identifier with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Fund Type describes the fund category, with no canonical ontology counterpart matching the entity.entity_type enum for the trustee subject.
Fund Status describes the fund's regulatory status and concerns the fund rather than the trustee; no clearly equivalent canonical enum mapping is supported for this subject.

Register Address is an address of the fund registration and is not established as the trustee's full address; street-address composition is not supported by the ontology address.full definition for this field.
Postal Address is a postal address of the fund contact rather than the trustee's business address, so subject ownership is not established for address.full.
Contact Person is a contact name with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Contact Telephone Number is a contact detail with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Contact Facsimile Number is a contact detail with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Licence Number is an RSE licence identifier with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Class of Licence describes the licence class with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Current MySuper Product Name names a financial product, not the trustee entity, and has no canonical ontology counterpart.
MySuper Product Type describes a product category with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Product Unique Identifier identifies a MySuper product and has no canonical ontology counterpart for the trustee entity.
Employer ABN identifies an employer of a product and belongs to a different subject than the trustee, so it is not mapped to entity.abn.
Employer Name identifies an employer of a product and belongs to a different subject than the trustee, so it is not mapped to entity.legal_name.
